answer: Proof of Stake acts as a secure vault for capital, requiring agents to commit assets to participate in consensus. Similar to a lagoon stabilizing tidal force, a tiered staking terrace enforces escalating economic costs on Sybil actors. By tethering network authority to locked capital rather than ephemeral digital identities, an attacker must acquire significant supply to gain influence, rendering the marginal cost of spawning fake nodes prohibitive against the potential loss of their principal investment.
